concept: How far a task has come, as the slider channel carved into the pane with the loud solid filling it from the leading edge.

default_to_avoid.pattern: a Progress bar in the brand blue with a striped animated fill
default_to_avoid.kind: progress bar, loading bar, upload bar
default_to_avoid.why_not: blue is a hue in a control and stripes move across the whole bar; Pane keeps controls without hue and motion slow

derivation.consequence: the scene supplies the hue; the system owns no hue of its own, only white at opacities and one ink, and colour appears only where it states a status or marks a diagram
derivation.form: the fill is the loud solid that a chosen value uses everywhere, white in dark and ink in light, with no hue

derivation.consequence: light falls from above, so every surface carries a rim brightest along its top edge and a soft shadow below that says where it floats, and a recess is the inverse, shaded under its top lip and lit on its bottom lip; a nested surface adds no second blur, because one sheet of glass is one layer
derivation.form: the channel is the same carve as the slider track, shaded under its top lip, so it reads as a groove in the pane

derivation.consequence: long ease-out curves (420 to 640ms) for arriving and hovering, a shorter one (200ms) for pressing because a press is a reply; under reduced motion every duration is zero at the token level
derivation.form: the fill grows on the long ease when the value changes and an unknown task travels slowly; under reduced motion it stands still

variants.reason: A shares the slider channel (P3) and has no hue (P1). B brings a hue and busy motion. C hides the amount in a small circle.

root.why: the label row and the channel stack with a small gap so they read as one thing

head.why: the label and the amount share a row so the amount sits at the end where the eye finishes

label.why: the label is in the label size and primary tone because it names the task

value.why: the amount is secondary and set in tabular figures so it does not jitter while it counts

track.why: the channel is carved into the pane like the slider track, shaded under its lip

md.why: the default channel is a little thicker than the slider so it reads from across a page

sm.why: the thin channel fits inside a card row or a list row without crowding its text

fill.why: the fill is the loud solid lit from above and glows softly in dark like a slider range

unknown.why: an unknown amount shows a third of the channel travelling slowly from start to end

@media forced-colors: active.why: in forced colours the system draws the edges and the fill so the parts stay findable

@media prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.why: under reduced motion the travelling fill stops and fills the channel faintly instead of moving

@travel.why: the travelling fill moves along the inline axis, so it runs right to left in RTL

inline-size.why: the fill grows on the long settle ease when the amount changes instead of jumping
